City id prague is unused in existing packs. Display Prague. Agency PID (coordinator ROPID) / DPP (operator). Do not invent city=praha, city=pida, city=pid, or merge into another Czech city — none exists yet.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: Metro A, B, C only. OUT: Line D (under construction, no passenger service as of 2026, earliest 2031-2032); tram; bus; trolleybus; funicular (Petřín); regional rail (Esko); ferries; bike-sharing. Tracker's 'Metro A-C + Esko' / 'A/B/C/D' notes are stale per the oracle report's explicit correction.
Timezone Europe/Prague HAS DST (CEST/CET), last Sunday of March / October. Do not copy Perth / Brisbane / Auckland no-DST handling.

Three lines: A Nemocnice Motol - Depo Hostivař (17 stations); B Zličín - Černý Most (24 stations, longest); C Letňany - Háje (20 stations, oldest, opened 1974). 61 line-station ticks (17+24+20); 58 unique station strings after removing the three double-counted interchange names (Muzeum, Můstek, Florenc each counted on two lines). The oracle report's phrase '61 unique D1 metro names' is the tick count, not the unique-name count — flagged as a hazard, resolved the same way Brussels distinguished lineTicks (94) from uniqueNames (60).

Hub lock: Muzeum (A x C), per this task's instruction and the oracle report's 'Muzeum listed first' tracker note. Secondary interchange: Můstek (A x B). Third vertex: Florenc (B x C). No single station serves all three lines. Muzeum is a hub stop string, not a direction token.

doNotGroup Muzeum vs Můstek vs Florenc (three distinct two-line nodes forming an interchange triangle, not one hub). doNotGroup Metro A/B/C vs Line D, tram, bus, trolleybus, funicular, Esko, ferries (all out of v1, same PID GTFS zip carries all modes).

Diacritics are load-bearing, not decorative (Můstek, Náměstí Míru, Jiřího z Poděbrad, Vysočanská, Nádraží Holešovice, etc.). Lock the full-diacritic official form; a stripped-diacritic string is a different, wrong string, not a rename. Confirm PID GTFS stop_name uses matching diacritic forms at D2 (some feeds ASCII-fold).
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the official line letters A, B, C printed on the PID map (not extracted from GTFS). No stopIds in this file.
